messages:
Ava (People Ops): Heads-up new manager quickstart checklist (compact) for the first week — copy this into your onboarding doc and ping me if anything is missing. :memo:

Sam (Hiring Manager): Love a compact version. Can we call out critical read access (analytics + billing) explicitly?

Ava (People Ops): Good call. Compact checklist below (Day numbers are recommended):
Day 0 - Pre-boarding:
- Confirm laptop & accessories shipped, add manager to payroll, complete background check paperwork.
- Create recurring 1:1 and 30/60/90 review slots in calendar.
- Send welcome note to direct reports + simple intro template.

Day 1 - People & access:
- 09:00 Team intro (30m) — quick personal intros & team priorities.
- 10:00 Manager sync w/ hiring manager (15-30m) — role expectations and ramp goals.
- 14:00 IT handoff: confirm Okta/SSO, Slack/email, VPN, analytics read, billing dashboard.

Day 2 - Systems & safety:
- Request GitHub org membership and repo access.
- Security primer (15m) + sign data handling guide.
- Ask for service account + alerting read access if you will see alerts.

Day 3 - Ship something small:
- Identify a tiny doc or bug to own and close; we prefer a visible early win.
- Draft 30/60/90 and share with your manager for feedback.

By EOW:
- Finalize 30/60/90 goals and publish to your manager & people ops.
- Schedule cross-team intro meetings (PM, Platform, SRE) as needed.

Sam (Hiring Manager): For analytics/billing access: please request via the "Access Portal" and set "urgent" for early hires.

Taylor (IT): @Jamal I can pre-provision analytics read + billing read. DM me your corp email. For SSH: run:
```
ssh-keygen -t rsa -b 4096 -C "jamal@redwood.com"
cat ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub
```
Paste pub key into Access Portal -> Tech Access. I'll attach repo groups.

Jamal: Sending email now. Also, what's the recommended 1:1 cadence? Weekly is fine?

Ava (People Ops): Weekly 1:1 for 3 months, then adjust. Skip-levels at 30/60 days recommended. Also add a biweekly team retro after week 2.

Sam (Hiring Manager): Agree. Also note hiring manager should set expectations around decision autonomy in week 1.

Ava (People Ops): Template links (SSO required): 30/60/90 template: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/templates/30-60-90 and intro email template: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/templates/intro-email

onboard-bot: Reminder scheduled: Complete pre-boarding forms (due in 48 hours).

Taylor (IT): If anything blocks provisioning, tag #help-it and include "new-manager" in the subject.

Jamal: Thanks everyone — copying this into my personal onboarding doc. Appreciate the quickstart!
